name: Christophers AI Poster
author: Christopher Smith

sections.description:
Christophers AI Poster lets you generate SEO-optimized WordPress draft posts with a click. It calls OpenAI with your prompt and saves the returned HTML as a draft post. Designed for simplicity: set your API key, prompt, model (e.g. gpt-4o-mini), and an optional max token limit (up to 16000 for long articles).

Highlights
* One-click “Generate Article” button from the plugin settings.
* Respects WordPress capabilities (admins only).
* Cleans up model output safely:
* Removes an initial <h1> to avoid double titles.
* If the model returns a full HTML document, it keeps only the <body> contents.
* Strips leading empty blocks (<p>, <br>,  ) that can create a large gap under the theme title.
* Security-minded admin UI with proper output escaping.

Usage

  • Craft a clear prompt. If you want a specific structure, ask the model to return an HTML fragment (no doctype/head/body) and start with an <h1> for the article title.
  • The plugin extracts the <h1> (or <title> if present) for the post title and removes that heading from the body to avoid duplicate titles.
  • Posts are saved as draft — review and edit before publishing.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install from a ZIP.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → AI Poster, enter your OpenAI API Key, Prompt, suggested model (e.g. gpt-4o-mini), and optional Max Tokens.
  4. Click Save Settings, then use Generate Article. The draft will appear in Posts → All Posts.
sections.faq:
Why did I see a big space under the title?

If the AI returns a full HTML document or leading empty paragraphs, that can create a top gap in some themes. Since v1.0.6 the plugin normalizes the content: it keeps only the <body> contents and removes leading empty blocks.

Does escaping add extra visual spaces?

No. Escaping is used only in the admin settings UI and doesn’t affect the saved post content.

Which models work?

Any compatible OpenAI chat model. We recommend gpt-4o-mini. You can use up to 16000 tokens for long articles.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • Fix: Normalize model output to prevent large spacing under the theme title (strip full HTML wrappers and leading empty blocks).
  • Tweak: Prefer <h1> for title; fall back to <title> if present.
  • Security: Proper escaping in settings fields; explicit script version.

1.0

  • Initial release.
